jobs.title: Implement codex — close gemini's 3 V1.5 provenance findings
jobs.objective: Close exactly the 3 findings gemini identified in docs/dogfood/055/review/build/gemini/REVIEW.md. NO scope creep. Spec: gemini's REVIEW.md IS the spec. (1) Finding 001 HIGH — weak attestation check in _recorded_artifact_attestation_chip (service.py:278): regex-matching author_line for attested status is forgeable via --allow-no-process-execution override. Fix per gemini correction: UI must only claim 'attested' if attestation_override_rationale IS NULL AND the byline matches expected_author_line. (2) Finding 002 MEDIUM — real-time recomputation of verdict attestation in _shape_verdict_rows (service.py:683): re-evaluates attestation per page load, causing valid attested verdicts to flip to 'unattested' once supervisor closes. Fix: at minimum, distinguish 'previously attested (session closed)' from 'never attested' rather than collapsing both to the same warning. (3) Finding 003 LOW — LaneEvidenceChip hardcoded to not_yet_correlated (service.py:710): when attestation_override_rationale IS NOT NULL, chip should surface 'override' with rationale. Update or add regression tests for each.
